verdict.rationale: INPI is a government IP-office portal for filings, databases, and business formalities. It is not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client and use tools from plugged-in servers, so this client-side axis is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it hosts an agent or connects to MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
